names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 27 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Κήρυκος «ὁ ἐν Ἄπρῳ»», with the rank word left off. The page spells the name with eta, Κήρυκος, and not Κύρικος.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Κήρυκος «ὁ ἐν Ἄπρῳ»»

attestations.note: The page gives one sentence — he practised ascesis in Thrace, near the city of Aprus, and fell asleep in peace — with no year at all, and a couplet addressed to him as Father. It prints no hymn. He is not the Cyricus son of Julitta whom the corpus keeps in July; this page's spelling is Κήρυκος, with eta.
